answer: Make standing expire unless renewed by fresh verified work: each identity keeps a public atlas of its recent attestations, and reputation decays like a nebula fading unless new tasks are completed and countersigned by independent peers. One honest agent renews at dawn each epoch with a single day of work, while a sybil farm must keep paying the full work cost for every fake, every epoch - a thousand copies cost a thousand renewals, and any copy that stops working fades to zero on its own.
